{{incomplete|needs=}} The following is a list of all of the {{pmin|Denmark|Danish}} home video releases of the [[Pokémon animated series]] and {{pkmn|movie}}s. All DVDs are Region 2. ==Main series== ===K.E. Media=== K.E. Media distributed these VHSes and DVDs in Denmark. ====VHS==== K.E. Media distributed two different series on VHS. While the first series did not have a name, the second series had the text {{tt|Serie II|Series II}} written on the front, right next to the volume number. However, they are commonly known as ''the red series'' and ''the yellow series'', respectively. =====The red series===== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background:#{{colorschemelight|Kanto}}; border:3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Kanto}}; {{roundy|10px}}" ! ''[[AG040|Pikachu i stødet]]'' ''("Watt's with Wattson?")'' | Unreleased |} ==Movies== [[File:Pokémon_Filmen_Danish_logo.png|thumb|300px|Pokémon Filmen]] All the movies dubbed in Danish from [[M01|Mewtwo Strikes Back]] up to [[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]] have been released on home video in Denmark. This excludes [[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]] and [[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]], which never were dubbed in Danish. Subsequent movies have been released on Netflix and [[Pokémon TV]]. The first four movies have been released on VHS and all 13 dubbed movies have received a DVD release. Every movie released on DVD in Denmark has had audio tracks in at least one other language. The only other language which has been a stable throughout all of the Danish releases is Norwegian. An English audio track has been included on all releases besides the three movies released by SF Film. Nordisk Film later acquired the rights to rerelease several movies, but unlike previous releases, the covers were in English, featuring movie descriptions in Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, and Finnish. {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background:#{{colorschemelight|Kanto}}; border:3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Kanto}}" |- !
